notes.title: First Patch
notes.notes:
Once again we'd like to thank everyone for trying out our prologue. 

As promised we've just released the first patch fixing the most important issues.

Below is a list of all the changes.

 Fixed bug with getting stuck after quickly switching tools with a controller.
 Greatly improved collisions between the skid-steer bucket and the ground. It should no longer get stuck in the ground.
 Construction job - Improved detection ranges for garage beams - materials placed below them should now always be recognized as in range, even for the roof.
 Fixed bug where sometimes the task for digging would not appear after building the office.
 Performance improvements.
 External camera now follows vehicle rotation. 
 Slightly improved ground resistance when digging - more improvements are in the works.
 New bonus task! - Place debris inside the container. With improved bucket collision scooping debris from the ground is much easier and more fun so we decided to add this task for the more ambitious among our players.

Tutorial changes:

 Slightly changed few tutorial messages to be more clear.
 It is no longer possible to destroy the old shack before the jackhammer is unlocked. 
 Disabled the ability to switch cameras in the skid-steer at the start of the tutorial. 

Known bugs:

 Don't exit the skid-steer if the right side touches the fence - you may get stuck.



Please note that if you already know how to play or just want to play your own way you can disable the tutorial when starting a new career.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865535/c451985a29a4c44e063b33b29241abc2d51346f8.jpg

We sincerely hope these changes will improve your experience with the game.
If you happen to find a bug or have suggestions on improving Demolish & Build 3 please share it on:
Discord: https://discord.gg/AmSQNSAjzE
Steam forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2803230/discussions/

notes.title: Prologue Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello,

We want to express our gratitude for all the bug reports and suggestions we have received since the Prologue launch. It's truly awesome to have you here!

Reading and hearing your insights, we want to focus our work the following aspects of the game: 
[olist]

 Improve the tutorials to prevent issues related to not following the tutorial instructions.
 Enhance the detection of materials in range, allowing for the identification of materials on the ground below the flag.
 Improve collisions between the skid-steer bucket and the ground.
 Fix the bug where the game sometimes freezes when switching tools.
[/olist]
We aim to bring you a game update this week.

In further updates we want to improve digging mechanics by making ground resistance more realistic. 
We are also working on translating the game for the following languages


 Chinese
 German
 Italian
 Polish
 Portuguese
 Spanish


If you happen to find a bug or have suggestions on improving Demolish & Build 3 please share it on:
Discord: https://discord.gg/AmSQNSAjzE
Steam forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2803230/discussions/

notes.title: Demolish & Build 3 Prologue - Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
🏗️The site is ready, and the deal is set on both ends.

Turn up the radio and mood for the job as heavy equipment is coming to do the heavy lifting. Tools and materials provided, bring your safety gloves and shoes and mark the day.

Demolish & Build 3 Prologue is set to start construction works on 
March 1st, 2024.

🥾⛑️🦺🧤🎧⚠️👷✅Ok, you are ready to go.
[previewyoutube=x5cV7m8rwSc;full]https://youtu.be/x5cV7m8rwSc[/previewyoutube]
Demolish & Build 3: Prologue will include the first few missions of the full game and features:

🚧 Large excavator.
🚧 Skid steer.
🚧 Attachments
🚧 Physics-based track mechanics,
🚧 Vehicle controls based on real machines.
🚧 Full controller support,
🚧 Fully destructible objects and structures
🚧 Third-person and first-person camera modes,

A Basic Manual Training course for future foremen can be accessed on the main website in the form of a playable demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670/Demolish__Build_3/

Basic excavator training is also provided: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021130/Demolish__Build_3_Excavator_Playground/

Stay tuned for details of the contract. Stay cautious on the job site!

Dear Foremen,

Today is the day we lurk out of production to showcase what we were building in the last couple of months. Bringing this game together is a real challenge, but we are quite proud of what we have achieved so far and more than optimistic about what is to come.

In the upcoming weeks, we will share a little bit more of gamepad gameplay with vehicle controls and some other goodies.

We hope you'll enjoy it.

Yours,
Demolish & Build 3 Team.
